problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 5 delivery routes through 5 specialized checkpoints.

Each route consists of a sequence of checkpoint stops represented as pairs (Checkpoint, Processing duration),
where each pair specifies the checkpoint where the stop must occur and the time required for processing.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the stops must be completed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C1, 5) → (C2, 5) → (C4, 9) → (C3, 6) → (C5, 3)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C5, 7) → (C1, 3) → (C4, 3) → (C2, 4) → (C3, 6)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C5, 6) → (C2, 7) → (C1, 1) → (C3, 3) → (C4, 10)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C1, 7) → (C4, 5) → (C5, 9) → (C3, 7) → (C2, 3)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C5, 4) → (C4, 8) → (C2, 6) → (C3, 9) → (C1, 1)

Each checkpoint stop must be processed continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted,
and each checkpoint can only handle one delivery vehicle at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all stops at the checkpoints
so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
